briefing.text: Information Technology led all three sector boards on 2026-11-06: buzz 87.0 on News (+0.2 vs the day before, +6.1 over the week), 92.8 on X (-0.4, +0.3) and 93.6 on Reddit (+0.1, +0.6), with NVDA, MU and AMD among the lead tickers. Mentions fell day over day in the sector (-25% News, -12% X, -19% Reddit), and sentiment was mildly positive on News (0.11) and X (0.12) but flat on Reddit (0.01). On News, Financials rose to 75.3 buzz (+9.2 over the week; UBS, BAC, C) while Consumer Staples (-2.3) and Materials (-2.2) slipped, with mentions down 40% and 33%. On X, Utilities gained 1.6 (VST, CEG) and Communication Services moved up from rank 5 to 3 with mentions +10% (GOOGL, NBIS, META), while Real Estate fell 4.4 with mentions down 52%. On Reddit, Utilities was the steadiest riser (77.1, +5.5 over the week; VST, AES, CEG).

DKNG #1: 77 articles in 2 days, 57 negative; the lead story is Texas betting hopes amid prediction-market scrutiny, which fits the high attention but is mostly negative.
ABNB #2: 107 articles, 84 positive, mostly MarketBeat 'stocks to watch' lists; supports attention but is not company-specific news.
SHAK #3: 7 articles, 4 positive; an activist-target list ranks it 9th and a piece on earnings; little news, so the rank comes from market inputs.
FLUT #4: 11 articles, 7 negative; lowered 2026 outlook and paused buybacks after the Q3 call, which explains the attention jump.
LYFT #5: 26 articles; Q3 EPS of (0.03) missed consensus, and a Kalshi app-downloads market is the listed catalyst.
COST #6: 38 articles, 10 positive and 6 negative; a bullish price-prediction piece and retail watch lists, no clear single driver.
RKLB #7: 33 articles, 12 positive; Neutron progress and a pre-earnings run (earnings 11-09, stock +15.4% in 24h) explain the rank.
TAP #8: 16 articles, 12 negative; Q3 EPS of $1.46 topped estimates but the 2026 outlook was cut, which explains the ranking.

DKNG ranks first (score 0.988) because attention is 2.07 and X attention 2.01 standard deviations above normal, volume is 1.83 above normal, and the 24h price move was 8.65 sigmas (-21.5%). ABNB is second (0.947) on the highest X attention reading (2.09), attention of 1.74, volume 1.33 and a 5.2-sigma move (+12.2% in 24h); open interest is below normal. SHAK is third (0.882) with smaller readings (attention 0.39, X attention 0.44) but high percentile ranks (0.95 and 0.96) among scored topics; volume is near normal and no catalyst is flagged. All three are tier T3 and sit in the consumer and gaming group.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
